entry.action: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 71.33. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.

profile.description: Cava, also referred to as Cava Grill, is an American Mediterranean fast casual restaurant chain with locations across the United States. Cava is owned by the publicly traded Cava Group, which purchased Zoës Kitchen in August 2018.
profile.description_zh: Cava，也称为Cava Grill，是一家美国地中海风味休闲快餐连锁餐厅，在美国各地设有门店。Cava由公开交易的Cava Group拥有，该集团于2018年8月收购了Zoës Kitchen。
